entry.description: stop `RemoteSyslogAppender` from opening a second, unused UDP socket. It sends through the connection its background pump owns, but also inherited one from `UdpAppender` that nothing ever used, which bound `localPort` twice. A pump that cannot connect now reports it as well, instead of ending unobserved and leaving every later event queued behind a sender that is gone (audit da18b6fd-f034, implemented by @FreeAndNil)
